faqs.answer: The stopwatch accuracy is 10 milliseconds (one-hundredth of a second), displayed as minutes:seconds.centiseconds, sufficient for everyday timing needs.

faqs.question: Are lap records saved?
faqs.answer: Lap records are cleared when the page is refreshed. If you need to save records, we recommend manually recording or taking screenshots after use.

faqs.question: How are fastest and slowest laps marked?
faqs.answer: When 2 or more laps are recorded, the system automatically marks the fastest lap with 🏆 and the slowest with 🐢, helping you analyze performance.

countdown-timer.seo_description: Set custom countdown timers online for free. Visual progress circle, preset times, browser notifications. Perfect for productivity and cooking.

faqs.question: Will I get a reminder when countdown ends?
faqs.answer: Yes, a browser notification is sent when countdown ends. On first use, the browser will ask permission for notifications - please allow to enable the reminder feature.

faqs.question: How long can I set the timer for?
faqs.answer: Supports any combination of 0-23 hours, 0-59 minutes, and 0-59 seconds. Maximum countdown is 23:59:59.

faqs.question: Can I continue after pausing?
faqs.answer: Yes. After clicking pause, the countdown maintains its current state. Click 'Resume' to continue from where you paused.

note-pad.description: Create and organize colorful sticky notes. Auto-save to browser storage.
note-pad.seo_title: Free Online Note Pad - Sticky Notes
note-pad.seo_description: Create and organize colorful sticky notes online for free. Auto-save to browser, search notes, export to JSON. Simple and effective note-taking.

faqs.question: Are notes saved automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes, all notes are automatically saved to browser local storage. Even after closing the page or browser, notes are preserved when you return.

faqs.question: Where is note data stored?
faqs.answer: Note data is stored in your browser's localStorage, not uploaded to any server. Clearing browser data may cause notes to be lost, so we recommend regular exports for backup.

faqs.question: How do I backup my notes?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Export' button to export all notes as a JSON file. You can save this file as a backup.

faqs.question: How many notes can I create?
faqs.answer: There's no limit on the number of notes. Create as many as you need. Note that browser local storage has capacity limits (typically 5-10MB).
